title: Creative director’s scores for Phase 4, chat 12 review (first pass): chapters 16, 20 and 21 by rule group and whole, and the application kit with its exports A01 to A20
author: Creative director (oa-creative-director), subagent of the main session
basis: work/handoffs/phase-4/20261123_Chat-12-Review-Brief.md, creative director's lens; Master Brief section 6 rubric; the kit's export PNGs at true size in work/build/exports/phase-4/ (16 atlas files and chapter 20's pages, read at 1x, at twice size where detail mattered, and at half and quarter size for composition); the shared capture set's newsprint-1x/1440 plates (86) read in contact sheets at 0.6 scale, with captions checked whole in the newsprint-1x/rules/1440 captures; words and specifications from the chapter files 16-photography.json, 20-web.json and 21-atlas.json; the export HTML read by script where a picture raised a question
threshold: 4 on every criterion; an item is ready when every score is 4 or more and it has no Must fix

items.name: Chapter 16, Rules 16.1 to 16.4: choosing and framing a photograph
items.anchor: #rule-16-1 to #rule-16-4; specimens s-16-1-* to s-16-4-*; phase4_ch16_build.py

reasons.craft: The two federal photographs hold in black and white at 1x, each crop set by hand keeps the official, his hand and a resident in view, and the failures (an empty Rotunda, a Prussian duotone, a portrait crop that loses the official, a headline over dark coats) each show one fault.
reasons.clarity: Each rule's plate shows its point at a glance, and the shot list gives a newcomer twelve real subjects with where, how and status.
reasons.brand_fidelity: Black and white with no tint, words beside the picture or on a solid Charcoal or Newsprint panel, and the duotone failure names the brand-color tint as the fault.
reasons.usefulness: The crop rectangles for five ratios in the photograph's own pixels, the panel tokens with their 13.29 to 1 ratio and the shot list's rows are exact enough to act on.
reasons.evidence_honesty: Every caption and credit comes whole from the agency's record (John Prettyman, U.S. Army; Architect of the Capitol), and the licenses were read on the Commons file pages with their dates.
reasons.accessibility: Rule 16.4 states its contrast and its failure measures the ratio under the headline, and each crop carries its own alt (the accessibility reader's walks govern).

items.name: Chapter 16, Rules 16.5 to 16.7: the record behind each photograph

reasons.craft: The caption anatomy keys who, what, where, when and credit under the words in one clean row, and the record table and numbered markers sit on the same grid as chapter 13's tables.
reasons.clarity: A newcomer can learn the caption order from Rule 16.5's plate alone, and Rule 16.7's two crops with two alts show why alt text follows the crop.
reasons.brand_fidelity: The plates stay in the house's caption and label styles with no red, and the founder's credit form follows Rule 16.5 (D4-73).
reasons.usefulness: Credit forms for three makers, the consent table by case and the alt text rules by use give a producer the words to write.
reasons.evidence_honesty: s-16-6-failure credits the invented photograph "Photograph: Dustin Cathcart, Oath & Action." with no Illustrative label beside it, so a real person's name sits on an invented consent failure; I saw the credit on the plate (Should fix).
reasons.accessibility: Alt text written per crop is taught with a correct and a failing pair, and the placeholder takes live text and no alt.

evidence_honesty.first_reading_reason: Rule 16.5's failure teaches the exact honesty fault (a caption that claims anger and a seizure the record lacks), and the invented 14-year-old and her school each carry Illustrative beside them.
evidence_honesty.reason: NB-2: s-16-6-failure credits the invented photograph "Photograph: Dustin Cathcart, Oath & Action." with no Illustrative label beside it, so a real person's name sits on an invented consent failure; I saw the credit on the plate (Should fix).

items.name: Chapter 16, Rules 16.8 and 16.9: placeholders and generated pictures

reasons.craft: The placeholder frame (1 px keyline, four 12 px crop marks 6 px off each corner, 24 px padding) draws the same on Newsprint and Charcoal at both ratios.
reasons.clarity: Each frame says Placeholder and what it waits for in words, and V5's gray panel as the failure makes the reason plain.
reasons.brand_fidelity: The frame uses only the strong border and label tokens, and the Generated image tab is a solid Charcoal label in the house's style.
reasons.usefulness: Frame, edge, padding, words and caption are specified with tokens, though 16.9's correct caption leaves "[tool], [date]" as slots for an image not yet made.
reasons.evidence_honesty: A generated picture may never stand for a real event, and the failure shows exactly that: a generated hearing captioned and credited as a photograph.
reasons.accessibility: The placeholder is live text in a figure with no alt, and a generated image's alt begins "Generated image".

reasons.craft: The video card (16.13) is finished, but the storyboard and the vertical frame draw empty boxes with titles ("Placeholder: Dustin's voice over chart S04") where the guide already prints S04, so the plates never show the frame they teach (CD-S7).
reasons.clarity: Each plate asks its question in the first two seconds and the failures are clear, though two frames defer to chapter 23 ("Drawn in chapter 23", "Caption-safe area, set in chapter 23").
reasons.brand_fidelity: L8 signs the poster, red appears only on the step, and the name plate reads "Dustin Cathcart, Founder and Editor" as DR-301 set.
reasons.usefulness: Caption file formats by platform with their read dates, the card's parts and the 44 px Play give a producer the specification.

CD-M1.title: The Act page's two source links lose their word space.
CD-M1.what_and_fix: Where: A08, `20261121_Web-Act-Page-Comment-On-A-Proposed-Rule.html` and its PNGs at every width, and `s-20-8-correct`; cause in `work/build/app-kit/renderers/web-site.mjs` line 369. What: the page prints "The rule on the FederalRegister" and "The rule as a PDF ongovinfo.gov" (seen at true size). `.ws-links li a{display:inline-flex}` makes the words before the `ws-out` span an anonymous flex item, and its trailing space is dropped. Fix: set `.ws-links li a` to `display:inline-block` with the 44 px target made by `padding-block`, or wrap the link's words in one span so the flex item holds the space; rerun A08 and its exports and check both links at 1440 and 390 px.

CD-M2.title: The atlas home answers every question with the medical-bill answer, and opens lit with its question out of view.
CD-M2.what_and_fix: Where: A11 (`20261122_Atlas-Home-Page.html`), A20, and the home's plates; kit `atlas-page.mjs`. What: the page holds one "The short answer" for 16 questions (markup count), so pressing any other question lights its parts under the medical-bill answer (AX-M4 saw it live); and it loads with "Why can the same care produce different bills?" pressed, so the first screen at 1440 by 900 shows "This question reaches here" in three parts while the question sits near y 1370. Fix: (a) give each question the answer its own record holds, or, where the atlas stores none, have the answer area say so in the editor's words when that question is pressed, never another question's answer; (b) load the working page with no question pressed and every part at full strength; the guide's plates keep the pressed state with the question in frame. The data lead signs off the answers.
CD-M2.owner: engineer for the kit; design director for the specs; editor for the words; data visualization lead for the sign-off

CD-S1.title: Bring the home's whole circuit and its key above the 900 px fold.
CD-S1.what_and_fix: Where: A11 at 1440 by 900 (`atlas-page.mjs`, specs section 3.2). The drawing's bottom edge sits at 960 px and its key at 993 px, so the return to Wealth falls below Rule 21.2's first screen. Fix: lift both to 880 px or above by taking about 115 px from the head band's padding, the 25 px gap above the drawing and the lane spacing under the core row; keep the 2 px ink and every count.

CD-S2.title: Draw chapter 21's 1440 px crops at true size, or say their scale.
CD-S2.what_and_fix: Where: s-21-1-correct, s-21-2-correct, s-21-3-correct, s-21-5-correct, s-21-7-correct, s-21-9-correct, s-21-13-correct and s-21-15-correct (`phase4_ch21_build.py`, the kit's crops). Each 1440 px crop draws at about half size, so 13 px labels print near 6.5 px at 1x and the reader meets a picture of words. Fix: crop each to the part the rule teaches and draw it at true size within the 808 px stage (21.5's drawing and tags, 21.7's two rows, 21.15's drawing); where a whole 1440 frame must show, label it "at half size" and set the 390 px frame at true size beside it. In 21.13's 1440 dark crop, crop to the stepper column so the left half is not empty Charcoal.

CD-S3.title: Show How to read's legend at true size.
CD-S3.what_and_fix: Where: `s-21-how-to-read` (A16). The 1440 page draws at about half size, so every mark's meaning sets near 6 px at 1x. Fix: draw the legend from Signs and types through On every page at true size, cropped to its content column (it fits the 808 px stage), without the masthead, title bar and footer; keep the table of marks and rules beside or under it.
